SESSION 12 HOW CAN I RESIST EVIL? 
2. WHAT ARE THE DEVIL’S TACTICS? (Genesis 3) 
 
• The devil wants to destroy our lives. (John 10:10) 
– Doubt (Genesis 3:1, Matthew 4:3) 
– Temptation (Genesis 2:16–17) 
– Deception (Genesis 3:4) 
– Condemnation Creates doubt 
 
But, “there is… no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.” (Romans 8:1) 
 
 
 
 
3. WHAT IS OUR POSITION? (Colossians 1:13) 
 
• We are transferred from the dominion of darkness to the kingdom of Jesus. 
• We experience God’s love. 
• It’s a process—we won’t be complete until Jesus returns. 
 
 
 
4. HOW DO WE DEFEND OURSELVES? (Ephesians 6)  
 
“Be strong in the Lord…. Put on the full armor of God, so that you can take your stand 
against the devil’s schemes.” (Ephesians 6:10–11) 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Focus on Jesus – belt of truth (v.14) 
• “I am the truth.” (John 14:6)
